title: Lighting of space habitats: Influence of color temperature on a crew's physical and mental health

findings.quote: This demonstrates that health, well-being, and alertness are all influenced by light.

findings.consequent: People's health, biological processes, psychological processes
findings.quote: Inadequate artificial lighting directly affects people's health and alters biological and psychological processes.

findings.consequent: Circadian rhythms, physical and psychological disorders, health
findings.quote: The temperature of the light alters the circadian rhythms, causing physical and psychological disorders in the human body that affect health.
We can consider light as being the biggest indicator, powered by daily ocular stimulus, which allows us to reset the circadian rhythm.
Thus we can say that "static" artificial light¹¹ alters both our hormonal and our circadian rhythms.
One the one hand daytime light increases cortisol levels (a sunlight dependent hormone responsible for alertness) and makes us more active.
At night high melatonin levels in the blood help us to sleep.

findings.consequent: Timing of circadian rhythm, nocturnal melatonin production
findings.quote: Melanopsin is most sensitive to short-wavelength (blue portion of the spectrum) visible light (max 480 nm) ¹⁴ and studies on humans have concluded that it has a direct influence on resetting the timing of the circadian rhythm by suppressing nocturnal melatonin production¹⁵.

Light is also used effectively as a cure¹⁸ for people suffering from seasonal affective disorder¹⁹ (SAD), shift-work or jet-lag, caused by a lack of light during the winter or the desynchronicity of the light-dark cycle.
Furthermore, light has a strong influence on people's moods²⁰.
When performing a particular activity, such as reading, a non-appropriate light makes us feel uncomfortable.

findings.antecedent: Lighting systems not mimicking sunlight / stable prolonged artificial lighting
findings.quote: The implementation²¹ of lighting systems that do not mimic sunlight, as well as the use of stable prolonged artificial lighting that does not follow natural light patterns promotes feelings of sadness or irritability, feelings related to a biological and physiological human response to artificial lighting²².

findings.antecedent: Isolation and close relationships (in space habitats)
findings.quote: In these habitats, isolation and such close relationships with other human beings can create stress and interpersonal problems²⁴
and it is known that the interior design of space habitats improve the well-being of the crew.
“The warm white light (3,000 K) facilitates relaxation and improves wellbeing, while day-light (5,600 K) stimulates and activates the human body.”²⁷
“The warm white light (3,000 K) facilitates relaxation and improves wellbeing, while day-light (5,600 K) stimulates and activates the human body.”²⁷
A long-duration short-wavelength light exposure is a potentially effective countermeasure for fatigue and low performance³¹, particularly during biological night.

findings.antecedent: Dynamic lighting (reproducing chromatic diversity and intensity of natural light)
findings.consequent: Circadian system, pleasant atmosphere, crew alertness, performance
findings.quote: This type of lighting would reproduce chromatic diversity and the intensity of natural light. Being able to vary the intensity at a given time, depending on the activity to be performed and the time slot would help to prolong alertness and therefore performance.
It has been proven³⁹ that dynamic light benefits concentration and therefore work performance.

findings.antecedent: Crew control over their own space (according to needs, moods, activities)
findings.consequent: Crew members' sense of well-being, performance, motivation
findings.quote: If the crew can control their own space according to their needs, moods, and activities, and create exactly the right atmosphere, they will increase their performance and motivation.
“The dynamic changes in daylight have a positive influence on mood and stimulation³⁰”.
